campaign_text:
Certified Materials. Clearer Moves. Spring Forward.
We’re bringing certified material choices into the open, with performance designed for everyday movement. From certified recycled polyester to TENCEL™ lyocell, we share what goes into Verdant and keep the conversation moving forward together.
87% of materials by weight are certified sustainable. We use certified recycled polyester from post-consumer plastic bottles. We use TENCEL™ lyocell from sustainably managed forests. Every Verdant garment comes with a full supply chain disclosure. 45,000+ garments have been recycled through the Take Back Program. Every item includes a 3-year product warranty.
Move into spring with more clarity. 87% of our materials by weight are certified sustainable, and every Verdant garment comes with a full supply chain disclosure—so you can see what goes into the movement.
#Verdant  #MaterialTransparency  #MoveWithVerdant  #SpringMovement
